correctness.rationale: All integer domains m,n>=2 and 0<=r<=n are specified. Conditioning on one box gives the exact expectation of unordered equal-category pairs in the remaining m−1 boxes. Algebra yields Q/(2(m−1)) times positive binomial probability. Root discriminants give every sign and zero, conservation forces an actual negative integer frequency, and the two-root sample-size and infinite Diophantine claims follow by explicit inequalities. The standalone checker independently enumerates bounded labeled allocations and passed 174,349 exact assertions, supplementing the unbounded proof.

value.rationale: The spectrum of frequency-of-frequencies and the unbiased collision U-statistic are standard summaries in coverage estimation and diversity analysis. A complete two-wing sign law is a natural qualitative dependence classification, not simply a computed example. Every fixed non-singleton frequency has reentrant dependence as sample size increases, and the singleton covariance switches at the natural two-per-category threshold while richness retains an opposite diversity sign. Exact integer double orthogonality occurs infinitely often, distinguishing genuine correlation cancellation from numerical near-zero. These facts have direct implications for interpreting joint fluctuations of Good–Turing components and Simpson concentration under the uniform null; no generalization to nonuniform sampling is claimed.
